gen-gf-underdog-gf-stick: Underdog draws every curve at a single weight, with a horseshoe-wide c that announces itself. Stick follows in tubelike lines with exits open enough to let light through, and the heading earns its keep when big and brief.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-suse: SUSE has curves as hefty as a rope's body and bowls tipped open toward you like a ladle, which makes text friendly. Underdog's wide-mouthed, uniform lines take the lead above it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-suse-mono: SUSE Mono gives every letter extra space on both sides, with open curves and clear gaps that feel approachable and orderly. Underdog is the one to make a loud entrance; this sans quietly does the explaining.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tajawal: Underdog's strokes never swell or thin, like a drawn line with a horseshoe c. Tajawal follows with a broad, hooked c in a plain sans, so give the heading plenty of size and let the body stay modest.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tasa-explorer: A horseshoe-wide c and strokes that never vary in weight make Underdog instantly recognizable. Against it, TASA Explorer's curve ends stop like lifted brush strokes, and that softness is what makes this sans-serif pairing feel so approachable.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter keeps every small counter unclogged, so the text feels crisp and clean to follow. Underdog handles the shouting, with uniform strokes; the sans handles the detail.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-teachers: Underdog's uniform, horseshoe-open curves look like they were poured from a single stroke, bold and unmistakable. And Teachers answers in thin, steel-rod letters whose ink tapers out before touching, giving the sans a lighter, modern counterpoint.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-telex: Clean and unclamped, Telex lets its curvy letters spread out below a heading drawn like wire. Underdog is built to command attention; this plain sans is built to inform.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tenor-sans: Underdog pours its ink at one width, with a c opened wide like a horseshoe. But Tenor Sans brings faint stroke variation and c tips that never creep toward closing, which is this pair's sharpest difference.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-tirra: Loud, wide and unflinching, Underdog draws every line with the steadiness of a string pulled taut. Tirra's round forms, like open parentheses, keep a sans-serif paragraph moving without any strain.
